courses.summary: 以鑽石礦關閉後的地形重整與原生植生回復為例，研究材料、季節與驗收。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: A closed diamond-mine landforming and native-revegetation case studies materials, seasonality and acceptance. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
